suggested_lane.label: Grenell-Habba Congo transfer feud
suggested_lane.description: Posts relay a New York Times report that the White House is investigating a $17.6M transfer from a Congolese government-linked account to Texas security firm TX-AT. The money is at the center of a dispute between Trump allies Richard Grenell and Alina Habba Mildon.
